uses_en: Temporarily relieves nasal congestion due to the common cold, hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies temporarily relieves sinus congestion and pressure || Uses temporarily relieves these symptoms due to hay fever (allergic rhinitis) or other upper respiratory allergies: sneezing runny nose itching of the nose or throat itchy, watery eyes.
warnings_summary_en: Caution or warning advised under medical supervision for: Pregnancy, Lactation/Breastfeeding, High Blood Pressure, Diabetes, Heart Disease.
